sources: RealmSpeak table classes (magic_realm/utility/components/source/.../table) read as facts (Meeting*, Peer, Locate, ReadRunes, MagicSight, Curse, PowerOfThePit, Wish, BattleModel reposition/changeTactics/missile, ActionRow hide)
RealmSpeak MagicRealmData.xml (magic_realm/utility/components/resources/data) (Transform and TWT site tables)
meta.notes: Meeting, Peer, Locate, Loot, Reading Runes, Magic Sight, missile, hide, reposition and change-tactics agree between RealmSpeak and digests 03/04/05 (no differences). Curses and Power of the Pit names come from RealmSpeak; digests only name the Curses; effect wording paraphrased. Wish effects 4-6 summarised from digest 04. Not in the sources: the Hide table text itself and the Optional Missile / Fumble tables (excluded, optional rules).

dice.standard: Two dice, take the higher; modifiers add or subtract, then clamp to 1-6.
dice.oneDie: Characters with a "one die" ability roll a single die instead.

meeting.dice: two dice, take the higher (modifiers apply, clamp 1-6)

rules.Insult: May pay 5 Notoriety to turn it into No deal; otherwise Block/Battle.
rules.Challenge: May pay 5 Fame to turn it into No deal; otherwise Block/Battle.
rules.Boon: Take the item or hire for free; relationship drops one level until repaid.

missile.dice: two dice take higher (Archers one die; Crossbowmen two)
missile.note: Level shift applies to the harm level (N0 L1 M2 H3 T4); no excess-strength bonus.

2.text: middle unchanged, first and third swap

3.text: third unchanged, first and second swap

5.text: shift down/right, third wraps to first

6.text: shift up/left, first wraps to third

reposition.note: newX gives the OLD box number whose contents move into position X. One die, no modifiers.

changeTactics.dice: two dice per box, take the higher, no modifiers
changeTactics.appliesTo: Medium, Heavy, head, club and unhired native counters; never Tremendous monsters or native horses

1.name: Eyemist
1.effect: Cannot perform any Search; enhanced (card or spell) Peer is still allowed.

2.name: Squeak
2.effect: Cannot be hidden; is unhidden when cursed.

3.name: Wither
3.effect: Cannot hold active effort asterisks; all asterisk chits are fatigued when cursed.

5.name: Ashes
5.effect: Gold is worthless: it can be added to but not spent or subtracted from.

6.name: Disgust
6.effect: Fame is worthless: it can be added to but not subtracted from.

curses.note: Names and numbering agree between RealmSpeak and digest 04. The effect wording here is paraphrased from RealmSpeak behaviour; the exact 3.1 table text was not available. Digest 05 section 6.2 says Ashes counts recorded gold as -1 and Disgust counts Fame as -1 at scoring; RealmSpeak treats both as "worthless, cannot subtract". OPEN.

1.name: Fiery Chasm
1.effect: Every unhidden character, native and monster in the clearing is killed; visitors and hidden individuals are unaffected.

3.name: Terror
3.effect: All Light and Medium monsters, natives and horses in the clearing are killed; each character there wounds all Light and Medium Move and Fight chits.

4.name: Blight
4.effect: All of the target's active chits showing effort asterisks become wounded.

5.name: Forget
5.effect: All of the target's active Magic chits become fatigued.

6.name: Rust
6.effect: Each active armor counter of the target is damaged (intact becomes damaged, damaged is destroyed); armor cards and inactive counters are not affected.

1.name: Elsewhere (self)
1.effect: Teleport yourself to any clearing of your choice.

2.name: Elsewhere (other)
2.effect: Teleport another character, native or monster (not yourself) in the clearing.

3.name: Vision
3.effect: Look at the contents of one box or pile of the Setup Card.

4.name: Peace
4.effect: Peace effect (nothing in the clearing attacks you; see spell Peace).

6.name: Strength
6.effect: Gain extra strength for the next combat.

wish.note: Names from RealmSpeak result strings; effects 4-6 are summarised from digest 04 (peace, health, strength) because their exact rules text was not in either source. OPEN.
